description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Weeravila New Town, Lunugamvehera D/S Division, Hambantota District - (24/1186)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically declarations of title determinations for multiple land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" and contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership details, extents, and cadastral information. It involves land registrations and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
